note: Each rut segment = 7 numbers: centre x (0..1 west->east), centre y (0..1 south->north), heading (deg clockwise from north), length (m), width (m), uvBias (texture offset along the rut), fade (1 = full, lower at rut ends). Each turn = one decal using a tile of the turn atlas, drawn in the rover frame at its starting heading.
